description: A bacterial colony with abundant nutrients grows at a constant fractional rate, with no harvesting or mortality.
Рост числа абонентов спортзала постепенно замедляется по мере приближения к фиксированной вместимости зала.
Freshly brewed coffee in a ceramic mug cools toward room temperature at a rate proportional to their temperature difference.
At a boarding school, susceptible pupils catch norovirus from infectious pupils and later recover with lasting immunity.
Field mice reproduce in a meadow, owls consume mice and reproduce through successful feeding, and owls also die naturally.
A language-learning app reaches a finite market through both advertising and recommendations from adopters to people who have not joined yet.
A warehouse manager replenishes stock toward a desired safety level while customer shipments continuously remove products.
A hospital recruits junior nurses who gain experience and become senior nurses; senior nurses eventually resign.
A coffee roastery receives bean orders only after an eight-week delivery delay, while roasting steadily consumes its bean inventory.
A managed lake fish stock regenerates toward its environmental carrying capacity while fishing removes a fixed fraction each year.
A seasonal respiratory illness spreads through a community; recovered residents gradually lose immunity and become susceptible again, causing repeated waves.
A toy retailer responds to a sudden holiday demand increase with delayed supplier deliveries and amplifies its purchasing orders.
Студенческий дебат-клуб имеет ограниченную вместимость, выгорание участников и дополнительную кампанию приглашения после 60-й недели.
A three-variable Lorenz convection system with a butterfly attractor exhibits chaotic changes between its two lobes.
A nonlinear Van der Pol electrical circuit exhibits a sustained relaxation limit cycle.
A periodically forced magnetoelastic beam follows the Duffing equation and irregularly switches between two stable potential wells.
